business_problem: Power needed a shared data and identity foundation across countries, stores, and SAP workloads so it could stop working from siloed data warehouses and launch AI experiments without heavy setup each time.
solution_summary: Power uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Power needed a shared data and identity foundation across countries, stores, and SAP workloads so it could stop working from siloed data warehouses and launch AI experiments without heavy setup each time. BigQuery serves as the consolidated source of truth for previously siloed retail, logistics, and SAP data, serving as the storage layer. Looker gives 6,000 employees a common analytics layer on top of the centralized data foundation, serving as the serving layer. Vertex AI Search for commerce powers retail-search proof-of-concept work on the Danish site, serving as the serving layer. Gemini lowers the threshold for additional AI-driven proof-of-concept projects across the business, serving as the compute layer.

business_outcome: Power unified enterprise data for thousands of employees and made it much easier to launch new AI pilots on top of retail and logistics information.
architecture_clues: The centralized identity and infrastructure setup makes it possible to launch a PoC for 40 users with minimal effort
The unified data model spans stores in multiple countries and logistics operators
Vertex AI Search for commerce is already in production experimentation on Power’s Danish site
evidence_quotes: Power has been running proof-of-concept projects across Google Cloud AI capabilities, including Vertex AI Search for commerce on its Danish site and Gemini.
By using SAP BDC and Datasphere on Google Cloud, Power lifted on-prem SAP data into BigQuery without losing context.
Consolidating multiple data warehouses into a single source of truth built on BigQuery has made everything easier.
data_flow: SAP BDC and Datasphere data is lifted into BigQuery, Looker exposes one consistent view of the business across countries and functions, and Vertex AI Search for commerce plus Gemini operate on top of that foundation for new AI experiences.
